Śavara, pl., v. Śabara.
Sava = Vishṇu (1000 names).
Savana, a son of Bhṛgu. § 747b (Suvarṇotpatti): XIII, 85, 4146 (seventh son of Bhṛgu).
Sāvarṇa, a ṛshi or a Manu. § 264 (Sabhākriyāp.): II, 4, 110 (waited upon Yudhishṭhira).--§ 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 18, 1339 (ºsya Manor sarge, then Vyāsa will be one of the Saptarshis). Cf. next.

Sāvarṇi, a ṛshi or a Manu. § 266 (Śakrasabhāv.): II, 7, 292 (in the palace of Indra), 293 (the same?, do.).--§ 565 (Gālavacarita): V, 109, 3789 (atra--i.e. in the south-Sºnā caiva Yavakrītātmajena ca maryādā sthāpitā, brahman, yāṃ sūryo nātivartate).--§ 730 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 14, 692 (ṛshiḥ, gratified Śiva in the Kṛta age). Cf. the prec.
Sāvitra^1 (“the son of Savitṛ [i.e. Sūrya]”) = Karṇa: I, 5386; XIII, 6253 (ºḥ kuṇḍalaṃ devyaṃ…dattvā gate lokān anuttamān, cf. XII, 8598). Cf. Sāvitrin.
Sāvitra^2, a Rudra. § 665 (Mokshadh.): XII, 208, 7586 (enumeration).
Sāvitra^3, a Vasu. § 775 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 151, 7094 (enumeration).

Sāvitra, adj. (“belonging to Savitṛ”). § 600 (Ghaṭotkacavadhap.): VII, 157, 6954 (sc. astraṃ, employed by Droṇa). § 694b (Jvarotpatti): XII, 284, 10212 (Meroḥ śṛṅgaṃ… Jyotishkaṃ nāma Sºṃ).--§ 759 (Ānuśāsanik.): XIII, 104, 5014 (ºāṇi, sc. mantrāṇi?).
Sāvitra(ṃ)^1, name of a nakshatra (“belonging to Savitṛ”) = Hasta. § 208 (Astradarśana): I, 135, 5376 (pañcatāreṇa samyuktaḥ Sºeṇeva candramāḥ).
Sāvitra(ṃ)^2 (sc. upākhyāna(ṃ)). § 10 (Parvasaṅgr.): I, 2, 332 (in the enumeration of parvans, entered among the parvans of the fifth book, but not found there).

Sāvitrin (“the son of Savitṛ [i.e. Sūrya]”) = Karṇa: XII, 8598 (ºī kuṇḍale divye…brāhmaṇārthe parityajya jagmatur lokam uttamaṃ, cf. XIII, 6253). Cf. Sāvitra.
Sāvitrīputraka, pl. (ºāḥ), a people. § 604 (Karṇap.): VIII, 5, 138 (had been slain in the battle).
Sāvitryavarajā (“the younger sister of Sāvitrī^2”) = Tapatī: I, 6522, 6605 (Tº).

Savitṛ (“impeller”), one of the Ādityas, sometimes identical with Vivasvat (Sūrya, the Sun, personified). § 3 (Anukram.): I, 1, 42 (a son or form of Vivasvat, cf.
